title: Characterization of a Consecutive Rank Test
statement: Given any Boolean acceptance function $a$ on $\mathbb{N}$ and natural numbers $i$ and $\mathrm{count}$, the test of the $\mathrm{count}$ consecutive ranks starting at $i$ returns true if and only if there is a rank $j$ with $i\le j<i+\mathrm{count}$ and $a(j)=\mathrm{true}$.
replaced:
Testing $\mathrm{count}$ consecutive ranks starting at $i$ against an acceptance
function returns true if and only if some rank $j$ with
$i \le j < i + \mathrm{count}$ accepts.
